turns.user: How long do I have to report an unauthorized transaction that shows up on my statement?
turns.answer:
Under Regulation E you must notify us of an unauthorized electronic‑fund transfer that appears on a periodic statement **within 60 days of the date we send you that statement**. If you miss that 60‑day window, your liability is limited to any additional unauthorized transfers that occur after the 60 days, unless we determine you had a good reason for the delay (in which case we may extend the deadline to a reasonable period【1005.6(b)#2】).

If you do report the unauthorized transfer within **120 days of the date the transfer was posted to your account**, we can limit your liability for that transfer as provided in § 1005.6(b)(3)【1005.18(e)#1】.  

So, to protect yourself, aim to report any unauthorized charge within 60 days of receiving the statement; you still have up to 120 days to report the transaction and keep liability limited.
